AdminUserCreate.title: AdminUserCreate
AdminUserCreate.description:
New account. The password is temporary: the user must change it at first login
(``must_change_password`` is set). The username is stored lower-cased; the ``gw-``
prefix is reserved for gateway users. Unknown fields are rejected (422).

AdminUserUpdate.title: AdminUserUpdate
AdminUserUpdate.description:
Partial update: only the keys sent are applied (``null`` is rejected). Unknown fields
are rejected (422).

AnesthesiaCaseWrite.title: AnesthesiaCaseWrite
AnesthesiaCaseWrite.description: Full-aggregate create-or-replace body (server-owned fields are not accepted).

DocumentDTO.description: A generated, stored PDF. ``storage_path`` is deliberately absent (admin DTO only).
